scope: Single training-only warm continuation with explicitly longer preparation and reset optimizer history. No independent initialization, held-out score, or controlled speed comparison.

declaration.gate: Unchanged 90% zero-start mean-response energy; last accepted iterate and eligible termination.
declaration.purpose: Continue fitting with explicitly longer preparation after gradient sensitivity audit. This changes the finite-preparation objective, not model dynamics.
declaration.history: Exact saved parameters; reset curvature history. Not an independent initialization.
declaration.failure_policy: No silent retry, budget extension, or dynamical changes. Retain failed evaluations.
declaration.scope: Training only; no new held-out claims.

warm_start.optimizer_state: fresh L-BFGS history; no Adam moments
warm_start.epoch_convention: accepted L-BFGS iterations; trial evaluations separately logged

sharing.provenance: Graph annotations when available; matching terminal L/R names otherwise. Suffix pairing is an explicit modeling assumption, not a biological annotation.

fitting_optimizer.coordinate_transform: theta = initial + scale * z; frozen coordinates unchanged

manifest.selection: minimum training MSE among accepted iterates, earliest tie; line-search trials are not selectable
manifest.scope: Training subset only. Native fit_config retained for parameter/checkpoint compatibility; fitting_optimizer controls this diagnostic. No priors or dynamical changes.

result.capacity_gate_definition: last accepted iterate captures at least 90%; nonfinite termination cannot pass; optimizer convergence is reported separately

audit.scope: Independent NumPy dynamics and weighted scoring of Rust-exported training sufficient statistics; no held-out observations or generalization estimate.

numerics.scope: Frozen parameters, independent NumPy replay on training targets only. Step/preparation variants and a zero-current control are diagnostics, not refits or held-out scores. Prediction energy is measured on observed target-neuron traces using the same confidence weights.

residuals.scope: Training-only least squares shared across selected targets with frozen dynamics. Positive scale is an optimistic calibration diagnostic; a zero multiplier is a limiting value for log gains. Signed scale is an inadmissible readout diagnostic, not a proposed model. No held-out scoring or checkpoint selection.

stationarity.scope: One frozen training checkpoint, existing objective and raw active parameter coordinates. No parameter updates, finite-difference claim or held-out selection. A small gradient does not prove global optimality or sufficient model capacity; this is not an optimizer termination report.

preparation-gradients.scope: Three frozen-parameter training objective/gradient evaluations. Only preparation duration changes by factors 1, 2, 4. Active raw-coordinate gradients; no fitting, held-out scoring, or independent AD verification.
